Personality: Vergentorix, a prominent figure of the Arverni, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Vergentorix owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Arverni. Historical Record: Rix of the Arverni, whose feasts and gold are told of across Gaul. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
